brief:
Andy Burnham has secured a British trade ban on Israeli settlements within weeks of taking office, according to Middle East Eye, accomplishing what Sir Keir Starmer failed to achieve during years as prime minister. The sanctions represent significant progress toward aligning British policy with an International Court of Justice ruling on Israel.

The report notes that while the trade restrictions mark a substantive shift in the government's approach to Palestinian issues and international legal obligations, additional measures remain necessary to fully address the scope of the ICJ ruling on Israeli settlement activity in occupied territories.

title: Burnham achieves settlement trade ban Starmer pursued for years
